pose.name: T-pose rig review
pose.method: Loaded the existing Tripo-rigged candidate in Three.js and rotated both arm chains in memory to align with the shoulder-derived lateral axis. No geometry, skin weights, or GLB data was modified or exported.

limitations: These images are derived candidate-rig review views, not Tripo-generated multi-view source references and not replacements for the approved single-view concept.
The candidate GLB contains one skinned mesh with the staff/weapon merged into the character; the weapon visibly obstructs the left arm in front and back views.
The candidate's arm-root bind-pose heights are asymmetric; the image pose does not repair the native rig or establish deformation quality.
The candidate GLB contains no native animation clips; these review poses are not animation evidence.
